governor_visit.title: Governor of Kafr El Sheikh Inspects AZAFCO Factory in Motobas Industrial Zone
governor_visit.summary: Governor Dr. Alaa Abdel Moaty inspects AZAFCO factory to enhance fish industries and develop export systems.
governor_visit.content: Governor Dr. Alaa Abdel Moaty visited AZAFCO Investment & Development factory in Motobas Industrial Zone as part of the governorate's efforts to enhance fish industries and develop the export system.

best_exporter.title: AZAFCO International.. The Best in the World of Fish Export
best_exporter.summary: Haj Mohamed Abdullah Al-Kuwaitihi, Chairman: We export to all countries.. and obtained EU approval to import our products.
best_exporter.content: A young man with great ambition, Haj Mohamed Abdullah Al-Kuwaitihi, Chairman of AZAFCO International, inherited the fish business and achieved a boom by opening up to foreign markets. He started in 2009, exporting directly to most countries thanks to EU approval.

tv_program.title: TV Program "Helwa Ya Baladi" - Special Episode About AZAFCO International
tv_program.summary: Special TV episode highlighting AZAFCO International and its role in fish packaging and export industry.
tv_program.content: The "Helwa Ya Baladi" program hosted AZAFCO International in a special episode covering the company's activities in fresh fish packaging and export.

egypt_ranking.title: Egypt Ranks 1st in Africa and 6th Globally in Aquaculture
egypt_ranking.summary: Egypt achieves advanced global positions in fish production and aquaculture, ranking 3rd worldwide in tilapia production.
egypt_ranking.content: Egypt ranks 1st in Africa and 6th globally in aquaculture, and 3rd worldwide in tilapia production. Egypt's total fish production is about 2 million tons annually.

kafr_el_sheikh_production.title: Kafr El Sheikh Produces 50% of Egypt's Fish Production
kafr_el_sheikh_production.summary: Kafr El Sheikh governorate - where our factory is located - is the top fish-producing governorate in Egypt with over 750,000 tons annually.
kafr_el_sheikh_production.content: Kafr El Sheikh produces nearly 50% of Egypt's total fish production, exceeding 750,000 tons annually.

ghalioun_project.title: Ghalioun Fish Project - Largest Aquaculture Project in the Middle East
ghalioun_project.summary: Ghalioun Lake project in Kafr El Sheikh is the largest fish farm in the Middle East and Africa, providing 15,000 jobs.
ghalioun_project.content: President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi inaugurated Ghalioun Fish Project on November 18, 2017. It is the largest fish farm in the Middle East and Africa.

iso_certifications.title: AZAFCO Obtains International ISO Certifications
iso_certifications.summary: The company obtained several international ISO certifications confirming its commitment to the highest quality and safety standards.
iso_certifications.content: At AZAFCO, we are proud to have obtained ISO 22000, HACCP, ISO 14001, ISO 9001, and ISO 45001 certifications.

baltim_factory.title: Opening of First Factory in Baltim Industrial Zone
baltim_factory.summary: AZAFCO's first factory opened in Baltim Industrial Zone, one of only 6 factories in Egypt authorized to export to the European Union.
baltim_factory.content: In 2018, AZAFCO opened its first factory in Baltim Industrial Zone, Kafr El Sheikh.

motobas_factory.title: Opening of New Factory in Motobas Industrial Zone
motobas_factory.summary: AZAFCO's new factory opened in Motobas Industrial Zone to expand production capacity.
motobas_factory.content: In 2025, AZAFCO opened its second factory in Motobas Industrial Zone, Kafr El Sheikh.

founding.title: Founding of AZAFCO International
founding.summary: AZAFCO International Investment & Development was established and began its journey in fish export.
founding.content: In 2008, AZAFCO International Investment & Development was established in Kafr El Sheikh governorate.
